question: For how many days is the Indian festival of Onam celebrated in Kerala?.
solution:
The correct answer is __Kerala__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Onam:

 
 
• It is a harvest festival of Kerala.
 
• It is celebrated to commemorate the arrival of King Mahabali.
 
• The festival lasts for** ten days.**
 
• It is also a harvest festival and falls on the 22nd Nakshatra Thiruvonam in the Malayalam calendar month of Chingam, which in the Gregorian calendar overlaps with August–September.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
